subject: Social Media
title: Reporting Systems That Fail
description: A quick, practical guide to Reporting Systems That Fail.

hook.text: You report harassment. The reply: 'This doesn't violate our guidelines.' Death threats continue. You're alone.

buildup.text: Report systems are built for scale, not nuance. They process millions of reports with templates. Subtlety dies.

discovery.text: Harassers learn the rules and stay just below them. 'Nice family' isn't flagged. The target knows the threat.

twist.text: Mobs abuse reports too. Mass-reporting a target's posts gets them auto-suspended. The system is weaponized.

climax.text: The reporting system protects the platform's liability, not the user's safety. Scale demands compromise.

punchline.text: The system wasn't built to protect you. It was built to scale.

quiz.question: How do organized mobs abuse reporting systems?
options: They mass-report targets to trigger auto-suspension
